Title: Runaway Kayak
Content:
:box:Keri visited Santa Barbara, California. On `text(May)` `10^text(th)`, she went kayaking in an ocean bay with calm water. She left her kayak on dry sand about `text(one foot)` from the waterline at high tide. She checked on the kayak `text(every few days)` to make sure it was still not touching the high tide waterline, and she made notes in her journal.

Keri decides to go kayaking again on `text(May)` `18^text(th)`. When she returns to the beach, her kayak is floating in the water.

During the high tide on `text(May)` `18^text(th)`, the water rose higher than earlier in the `text(month)`. Keri learns that tides are affected by the phases of the moon. She finds information about the phases of the moon for `text(May)` of `text(this year)` and adds it to the tide graph.
